Polished Fossil Slab Display Specimen
Late Triassic Period
Originating from northeastern Arizona, this petrified wood slab dates to the Late Triassic period, over 200 million years ago. Silica replaced buried wood fibers while iron and manganese oxides imparted rich tones of brick red, amber, and black. The piece showcases fine fossilization with a polished face and authentic rough outer bark.
Polished display face highlighting mineral banding and grain structure
Natural rough rind preserving the exterior tree bark texture
Flat cut bottom with four protective cork pads for upright display
Includes educational informational card on Arizona petrified wood
Dimensions: 7.2" H x 6.6" W x 2.2" D; Weight: 1.65 lbs
Condition:
Polished surface is smooth with natural internal micro-fissures inherent to fossilized stone. Natural rough edges are intact. Base is cut flat and stands upright securely; partial label residue on underside. Information card has handling creases.

Interior Packaging:

Damaged Item:

Overall Contents:

description:
Vintage Dip Pen Nib Collection  Esterbrook, Mallat, Muller & Others in Bering Cigar Box
Assorted collection of previously owned metal dip pen nibs and illustrated pen-nib boxes, housed in a wooden Bering Claro cigar box.
The collection includes assorted loose metal nibs and multiple small cardboard boxes from several manufacturers. Several boxes were reported as unopened.
Photographed Manufacturers and Markings:
Esterbrook & Co.  314 Relief Pens, boxes marked 100 Pens and Made in U.S.A.
Heintze & Blanckertz  German steel pen nib packaging, including boxes marked 144 Stuck Schreibfedern
Herm. Muller A.G.  Leipziger Stahlfederfabrik, No. 3703, marked 1 Gross Eilfedern
J.B. Mallat  French Plumes Metalliques, No. 12 Pointes Moyennes, boxes marked 100
Bering Claro  wooden cigar box marked Tampa, Florida
Some Esterbrook packaging includes distributor information referring to Cairo, Egypt.
The assortment contains numerous loose metal pen nibs of various shapes and sizes, including some gold-colored pieces.
Condition:
Previously owned collection with age- and storage-related wear.
The cardboard boxes show varying amounts of edge wear, discoloration, scuffs, creases, and surface marks. Some labels and packaging remain visually colorful, while others show more substantial wear.
Several boxes were reported as unopened. Their internal contents and quantities have not been independently inspected.
The loose metal nibs show varying surface finishes and possible discoloration or oxidation. Individual nibs have not been examined for corrosion, bends, or writing performance.
The wooden cigar box shows visible storage and handling wear.
Testing Classification: Untested. No writing or functional testing was performed.
The actual number of pen nibs and the contents of unopened boxes have not been verified. Quantities printed on packaging refer to the manufacturer's labeled contents and do not establish current quantities.
The exact production dates and metal compositions are unknown.
Included Contents:
One Bering Claro wooden cigar box containing the photographed assortment of pen-nib boxes and loose metal dip pen nibs.
Additional Information:
These items were donated and previously owned; their complete history is unknown. Photographs show the actual items and are part of the description. Only photographed contents are included unless specifically stated otherwise. Measurements are approximate when provided, and colors may vary due to lighting or display settings. Descriptions may contain unintentional errors. Buyers should review all photographs and ask questions before bidding. The items are sold AS-IS according to the testing and condition stated above.
BIDDING AGREEMENT. By bidding on our items, the bidder understands and accepts that the majority of our items are donations and are in used condition therefore, all items are being sold
AS-IS with no warranties expressed or implied
.

Items are described to the best of our ability through photographs and a written description. Bidders are responsible for inquiring about specifics not mentioned.
True North Goodwill is not liable for assumptions made.
We do not open or break down items, therefore unseen flaws or imperfections may not be shown or mentioned. If an item is past its due date before a message is received via customer service, we hold the rights to leave the item on your account for a probationary period or indefinitely depending on past offences (subject to change after item is reviewed by team leaders/manager). shipping.policy:
We use FedEx as our contracted shipping carrier and follow their packaging guidelines. Keep in mind, FedEx now uses a volumetric calculation to determine shipping estimates. This is called
dimensional weight
and refers to the amount of space a package occupies in relation to its actual weight. For more information regarding dimensional weight, please visit:
https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html
.
Once payment has cleared, orders are generally processed within 5 business days, not including weekends or holidays.
Goodwill Industries of the Inland Northwest will not be held liable for lost or stolen packages if they are marked
delivered
within the tracking details. It is the responsibility of the customer to contact the shipping carrier to inquire about the claims process for reimbursement. We are happy to provide the necessary paperwork to facilitate this process.
Purchased items will be shipped as specified within the order. We are unable to reroute packages once processed. Please ensure any address changes are made prior to payment during the checkout process. Per FedEx policies, we cannot accept P.O. boxes, please provide us with a physical address.
Buyers may also arrange their own third-party shipping service for pick-up only items. However, the carrier must assume all responsibility for the item and must be able to retrieve, pack, and ship. Please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry.
Combined shipping
Due to automation, items can only be combined prior to payment being received. Eligible items must meet the following criteria:
The items are from the same Goodwill location.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.
The combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
Items are not already in a fixed-price, flat-rate shipping box.
Items can't be purchased via buy-it-now or with 1 cent shipping.
You will be automatically prompted to combine all available items during checkout. If the site does not, please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry; some exceptions may be made.

shipping.policy:
Shipping:
Upon receipt of payment, we utilize FedEx as our shipping carrier. We do our best to have items shipped within 5 business days from the date of payment. Shipping charges are calculated at time of payment. Please check shipping rates prior to placing your bid. All items will be shipped as listed and will not be dismantled for any reason. Goodwill of North Florida does not provide refunds on shipping or handling costs.
FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the actual weight of the shipped package or some items may be calculated by dimensional weight (volume) - whichever weight is higher.
The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s)
. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on the following Monday. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.
Handling Fees:
A minimum of $1.99 up to $6.99 handling fee will appear at checkout and applies to all purchases regardless of delivery method or pick up. Our handling fee is a set fee that is non refundable and applicable to every item. No exceptions.
Combining shipping is a great way to save on shipping!
Contact us prior to payment to combine items
.
Items may be combined if:
Auctions close within 7 days of each other
Are safe to ship in one box without damage
All items must be paid for at the same time.
Multiple orders cannot be combined into one shipment
. Once a combined shipping charge has been calculated for an order, no additional items may be added to that order.
We reserve the right to deny combination of items. Items will not be dismantled or disassembled for any reason, no exceptions.

shipping.policy:
We strive to package/ship all orders within 2-5 business days of payment. Our dedicated shipping department is skilled in preparing delicate items. Rest assured your order will arrive in the same condition as pictured.
We ship exclusively via FedEx Ground/Home Delivery. *FedEx cannot deliver to P.O Boxes, APO, FPO, or DPO addresses.*
Combined Shipping:
You may combine items when:
1.) All auctions close within 7 days and
2.) All items are safe to ship in one box and
3.) All items combined do not exceed 20 lbs. (We reserve the right to deny a combination of items when necessary.)
ONCE PAID FOR, ITEMS MAY NOT BE COMBINED.
Handling charges will not be reduced.

description:
Mixed Lot 18-20 Polished Rough Gemstone Mineral Slabs Agate Jasper Wood
This lot contains approximately 18-20 various polished and rough gemstone or mineral slabs. Included are agate, jasper, petrified wood, and other unidentified stones. The slabs feature unique patterns, colors, and translucency with earthy tones such as browns, grays, greens, and creams. Some slabs exhibit banding and dendritic inclusions. The pieces are irregularly shaped with polished and natural rough edges, varying in thickness and size. Most slabs are in good condition with natural inclusions and minor edge chipping on some pieces.
